## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

DisplayFormatter — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/display/DisplayFormatter.kt

## Trigger

None — formatMinutesSeconds and formatDurationTotal are pure formatting functions already called from formatDurationSegment, formatDurationElapsed and formatPace; nothing new needs to call them

## Today

formatMinutesSeconds divides totalSeconds by 60 and takes totalSeconds % 60
directly, with no sign handling; on a negative value both the quotient and
the remainder are negative, so it renders minus ninety seconds as
"-1:-30". formatDurationTotal repeats the same pattern in hours, minutes
and seconds, producing the same garbling for a negative total. formatDelta,
in the same file, already extracts the sign with `if (totalSeconds >= 0) '+' else MINUS_SIGN`
and calls formatMinutesSeconds with `kotlin.math.abs(totalSeconds)`, so its
own output is correct.

## Expected

formatMinutesSeconds and formatDurationTotal extract the sign of
totalSeconds first, then compute minutes/seconds (and hours, for the total)
from its absolute value, and prefix the result with a minus sign only when
the input was negative — the same pattern formatDelta already applies.
formatDurationSegment, formatDurationElapsed and formatPace, which all
delegate to formatMinutesSeconds, inherit the corrected output with no
change to their own signatures.
